headline: EAAA India Alternatives opens today (to 28 Oct): P/E 41, GMP only ₹33 (2%), 100% OFS — listing gains slim, Neutral; Jio & Paras allot today

eaaa-alternatives.category_note: GMP just ₹33 (~2%) at P/E ~41 and 100% OFS; strong ₹360 Cr anchor book helps but skip unless you'd hold. Recheck subscription on 28 Oct.

jio-platforms.category_note: Allotment today (26 Oct), listing 28 Oct. GMP ₹247 (~22%) slipped from peak ₹273; final subscription 12.45x at Day 3.

paras-healthcare.category_note: Allotment today, listing 28 Oct. GMP faded to ₹9 (1.3%); expect a flat listing.

sfc-environmental-technologies.category_note: Opens 27 Oct. GMP back up to ₹32 (~10%) after dip to ₹21; recheck after anchors.

bls-polymers.category_note: Opens 27 Oct. GMP rising to ₹38 (~25%) since 19 Oct; recheck after anchors.

m-k-sons-fine-jewels.category_note: Opens 28 Oct. GMP ₹7 (~4%); recheck after anchors.

bombay-coated-and-special-steels.category_note: Opens 29 Oct. GMP ₹8 (~10%); RHP analysis still pending.
